title: 跨模型记忆迁移：目标端读取器适配研究
summary: 该研究探讨了Engram式哈希记忆在不同骨干模型间的迁移。通过冻结源模型训练的记忆，仅训练目标端轻量读取器，发现目标端读取器对齐至关重要。双分支读取器几乎弥合同模型与跨模型差距，平均得分38.8。若读取器接口兼容，冻结记忆可直接复用，适配可进一步提升。
summary_en: This study explores transferring Engram-style hashed memory across backbones. By freezing source-trained memory and training only a target-side reader, it finds reader alignment is crucial. A dual-layer, four-branch reader nearly closes the gap, achieving 38.8. Compatible readers enable direct reuse, with adaptation improving alignment.
